title: Curiosity-gradient routing contract (L6)
description: Boost cells with high gap_miner activity. See ADR-043.

invariants.name: normalized_over_fleet
must: result added to base_score in [0, curiosity_weight]

invariants.name: decays_with_success
invariants.description: Cell with falling gap_signals loses boost organically.
must: no separate decay code; normalization handles it
gap_signals naturally drop as cell succeeds

invariants.name: no_veto_interaction
invariants.description: Curiosity-boosted route is still vetoed if negative tunnel matches.
must: negative tunnel veto applied AFTER curiosity scoring

invariants.name: read_only_signal
must: no write to gap_signal table from routing path
